meta.title: VNT — Web design & development
meta.description: A design and development studio. We design and build websites and digital products end to end.

hero.title: We design and build the web presence of your business.
hero.subtitle: There are two of us: a designer and a developer. You work directly with the people doing the work.

services.title: What we do
services.intro: A small team covering the whole path: from the idea to a live, maintained site.

items.title: Product & brand design
items.description: Visual identity, design systems and interface design. Clickable prototypes before a single line of code.

items.title: Web development
items.description: Fast, accessible and maintainable sites and apps. Code we own, without odd dependencies.

items.title: Launch
items.description: Domain, hosting, analytics and technical SEO. We hand over a running, documented site.

items.title: Maintenance & growth
items.description: We keep iterating: new sections, performance work and ongoing support.

steps.title: We talk
steps.description: We learn about the business, who it speaks to and what the site has to achieve. No endless forms.

steps.title: A closed proposal
steps.description: Scope, timeline and price in writing. No surprises halfway through.

steps.title: Design & build
steps.description: We work in parallel, with weekly deliverables you can see and comment on.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: We ship, measure and adjust. We teach you whatever you'll need to handle yourself.
